thread:
Maya: Heads up team, Acme Payments POC kickoff tomorrow. They want streaming (SSE preferred), Rust SDK examples, function/tool callbacks to an internal enrichment service, and strict structured JSON outputs. Can someone lead the tech playbook?
Jonas: I got this. I'll prepare a Rust SSE example, callback signing guide, and a small runbook. Quick clarifying Qs: 1) are callbacks going to be our outbound webhooks to their internal service or reverse webhook? 2) what throughput should we size for?
Carlos: We expect up to 200 qps during peak with bursts to 600qps. Callbacks will be outbound from our infra to their private endpoint (they'll expose via connector). Data contains PII (masked PAN accepted), so we need KMS and token scoping.
Priya: For PII in POC: hosted is acceptable if they sign DPA and we enable zero-retention + ingress IP allowlist. Recommend Redwood Private for production. Also provide steps for scoped API keys and short-lived creds.
Eli: Security checklist from infra: SAML SSO, KMS (rotateable), audit logs, signed callbacks (HMAC). We can enable zero-retention logs during POC; will need customer sign-off for any extended retention.
Jonas: Draft snippet for Rust SSE client and callback verifier below:
```rust
// connect
let client = Redwood::Client::new(std::env::var("REDWOOD_TOKEN")?);
let mut stream = client.streaming("gpt-infer-1", &params).await?;
while let Some(event) = stream.next().await { println!("EVENT: {:#}", event); }
// callback verify
use hmac::{Hmac, Mac};
use sha2::Sha256;
let mut mac = Hmac::<Sha256>::new_from_slice(secret.as_bytes()).unwrap();
mac.update(body_bytes);
mac.verify_slice(hex::decode(header_signature)?)?;
```
Jonas: Callbacks should present header `x-rwd-signature` with HMAC-SHA256. Keep payloads <200KB; for larger blobs use presigned S3 references.
Maya: Pricing asked by buyer: they want a 2-week POC cost estimate comparing hosted vs reserved. Can Sales get a rough per-week ballpark?
Jonas: Quick calc: avg 200 qps, average session 400 tokens, streaming + tool calls -> ~2M tokens/day -> hosted ~ $5k/week. Reserved short-term estimate depends on GPU type; rough committed minimum $6k-$8k/week for guarantee. I'll make a more exact sheet.
Priya: Add note: reserved gives predictable latency and dedicated throughput; hosted is faster to start and cheaper for short spikes. Also include networking egress cost note for callbacks.
Carlos: I'll produce a 200-row sanitized JSON sample dataset (masked PANs, obfuscate names). ETA EOD.
Eli: I'll attach our completed security answers in the doc pack. Also specify KMS key ARN pattern and rotation policy.
Maya: We should include a small structured output schema example for payment_event and instructions to pass `structured_output_schema` param so model enforces it.
Jonas: Example schema string we can embed in the one-pager:
```json
{ "type": "object", "properties": { "payment_event": { "type": "object", "properties": { "amount": {"type":"number"}, "currency":{"type":"string"}, "status":{"type":"string"}, "masked_pan":{"type":"string"} }, "required":["amount","currency","status","masked_pan"] } }, "required":["payment_event"] }
```
Priya: Ops note: recommend callback proxy in their VPC for sensitive enrichment calls, use short-lived tokens and IP allowlist, and rotate signing secret per day for the POC.
Jonas: I'll include a small failure-mode runbook: 1) callback 5xx -> retry with exponential backoff 2) payload too large -> send presigned URL 3) signature fail -> log + alert + drop.
deploybot: workspace `poc-acmepay-2109990000` created, invites sent to acme infra.
Maya: Nice. Can we meet Thu 9am PT for a technical sync with Acme? I'll include draft one-pager in the invite.
Carlos: Confirmed, will upload sample JSON before sync.
Priya: I'll prep the security addendum notes and list required approvals.
Eli: I'll bring the short questionnaire answers and KMS details.
Jonas: One-pager draft to Maya within 12 hours.
Maya: Thanks all. :rocket:
